props.name: external
props.description: `external` marks a link that leaves the application: it adds the external icon, sets `target="_blank"`, and adds `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Left off by default because most links do not leave.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination. A link that navigates.

props.name: subtle
props.description: Suppresses the underline until hover or focus.

props.name: target
props.description: Opens in a new tab without the external treatment.

ai.summary: Navigates to another URL, in place or in a new tab.
whenToUse: The destination is a document or page
It can be opened in a new tab or copied by the reader
whenNotToUse: It performs an action without changing the URL — use a Button instead
It downloads a file rather than navigating — pass `download`
It triggers a dialog or menu — use a Button
ai.accessibility: Native anchor role, so middle-click, open-in-new-tab, and copy-link work. `external` sets target=_blank with rel=noopener noreferrer and renders a decorative indicator.
knownLimitations: An empty `href` renders as visibly disabled rather than failing at build time
